jobs.name: help_route
jobs.prompt: 1536x1024 3:2 landscape full-bleed photoreal. Same Ana olive shirt and Luis navy polo curly dark hair from reference give/receive directions. They stand SIDE BY SIDE on the SAME SIDE of a large paper neighborhood map on a waist-high information table, both faces visible at top, camera over table FROM SAME printed side so both humans and viewer read the same face. Luis points naturally with one complete right arm/index finger at map's route; Ana listens and looks at map, no extra hands. Map fills central lower 70 percent. Functional map: start bottom center, road runs straight UP then turns RIGHT; one blue L-shaped route up then right. Glass shopping MALL above rightward road (north side, traveller's left after right turn), BANK with ATM opposite mall below same road. Mall and bank recognizable by objects, NO names or words, no written directions. Brick corner location from reference. No collage, split panels, speech bubbles or answer text.

jobs.name: help_neighborhood
jobs.prompt: 1536x1024 3:2 landscape full-bleed. Precise functional city walking-route diagram with recognizable miniature realistic buildings and no words/labels. Vertical road comes UP from bottom center, T junction near middle then branch RIGHT. Glass multistory MALL with interior escalators on UPPER side of rightward branch; BANK with clearly modeled ATM directly OPPOSITE on LOWER side separated by road. Mall across from bank and on traveller's LEFT when walking RIGHT along branch. One thin blue path goes STRAIGHT UP from bottom to junction then RIGHT along branch, ends just before mall. No extra routes. Both buildings large legible on phone, all content centered with margin. This is a literal spatial map, not social conversation. No decorative marks/captions.

jobs.name: help_mall_left
jobs.prompt: 1536x1024 landscape3:2 full-bleed realistic street photograph from a pedestrian eye-level viewpoint walking straight along a safe sidewalk. Large glass multistory shopping MALL clearly on VIEWER LEFT with escalators, shops and atrium visible; BANK across street on VIEWER RIGHT with an ATM and one customer, no word signs. Road runs from bottom center into distance. Mall and bank directly opposite each other. Clear fronts, natural daylight, no principal human or pointing hand. No labels, captions, logos or watermarks. Keep same warm brick neighborhood mood. This is the view AFTER turning right and now facing along the final street.

jobs.name: mission_bus_route
jobs.prompt: 1536x1024 3:2 landscape full-bleed realistic bus interior photograph. Same blue city bus and blue seats, but new camera view for MISSION. Focus very large real printed route panel above bus windows: four clear separate illustrated stops arranged LEFT TO RIGHT: railway station with train, library with books, post office with envelopes/mailbox, dinosaur museum. Single blue line connects exactly FOUR stop dots in that order, no others. No words or letters. Each illustrated stop large with clear spacing/touch target, central panel occupies 85 percent width and 70 percent height. Ana olive shirt seen only seated lower foreground looking toward route; not overlapping the panel or stops. Real photoreal interior, not floating UI overlay or collage. Bright daylight, readable on phone.

jobs.name: mission_final_walk
jobs.prompt: 1536x1024 landscape3:2. Fresh MISSION functional navigation map, elegant architectural miniature realism, NO WORDS, captions, labels, border. Vertical road from bottom-right runs UP and turns LEFT at T junction in top-right third. One continuous BLUE route goes up past BANK with ATM just LEFT/west of the starting vertical road, then turns LEFT/west at upper corner, ending near museum. Along westward/top horizontal road: PHARMACY with green cross on SOUTH/bottom side (=traveller LEFT after turn), DINOSAUR MUSEUM on NORTH/top side (=traveller RIGHT). Four distinct nonoverlapping touch objects: bank lower middle, elbow corner upper right, pharmacy upper-middle below road, museum upper-left above road. Blue route clear, recognizable venue details. Compact entire map in frame with margin, no decorative arrows or other landmarks. All route geometry physically consistent.
